why: the initial number is what JSON reads, 1e+5 and 1.2e+3 with the + in their exponent, and the rest is text after it, as 10.0bar is the number 10.0 then bar; the + stands inside a number, so no forbidden character is in the text: the strings "1e+5.x", "1.2e+3.x" and "1e+5.5". typesafe/config and pyhocon reject them
